messages:
Jordan: Heads-up — Prom scrape bill spiked last 24h, looks like per-pod GPU-exporter cardinality is the culprit. dashboard: /dashboards/gpu-cost-by-label :warning:
Maya: Ugh. Any quick wins besides deleting labels? :cry:
Kevin: Short-term: drop non-essential labels and throttle scrape targets. Long-term: propose a node-level aggregator sidecar that emits aggregated per-node and optional per-pod when annotated. reduces series by ~90%. :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Jordan: Sketch of aggregator: runs as a DaemonSet, scrapes dcgm/node-exporter locally, aggregates per-pod gpu_util and memory by summing or max, exposes metrics under `redwood_gpu_node_...` and `redwood_gpu_pod_...` only if pod has `redwood.io/gpu_metrics: "true"` annotation.
Kevin: Nice. Do we keep DCGM per-GPU metrics for internal SLOs? we still need per-device metrics for infra debugging.
Maya: plan: keep full per-device on a small canary subset of nodes (label: gpu-metrics=full). rest use aggregator reduced set.
Priyanka: routing note: need relabeling in prometheus to prefer aggregator targets over per-pod exporter. Means changing scrape targets and relabel_config to drop original metrics. Sample relabel snippet I used in dev env:
```
- job_name: 'k8s-gpu-aggregator'
  kubernetes_sd_configs:
    - role: pod
  relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
      regex: 'gpu-aggregator'
      action: keep
  metric_relabel_configs:
    - source_labels: ['__name__']
      regex: 'dcgm_.*|nvidia_gpu_.*'
      action: keep
```

Kevin: We'll also need to tune scrape_interval and timeout. For aggregator job set `scrape_interval: 15s` and `scrape_timeout: 10s`. For per-pod full job, set 60s. cuts scrape load.
Ryan: How will alerts change? we currently alert on per-device temp/clock anomalies and per-pod GPU high usage.
Jordan: Keep hardware alerts on raw dcgm metrics (canary nodes). For user-facing SLOs use aggregated `redwood_gpu_node_utilization` and `redwood_gpu_pod_utilization` with 5m and 1h windows. Update alerting rules to fire on aggregated metrics.
Maya: Concern: network flakiness in eu-west-2 last month caused spikes in scrape failures — aggregator increases reliance on fewer endpoints, so a regional outage could hide per-device faults. We should add probe job to fetch raw dcgm via a sidecar on canary nodes and alert on probe success rate.
Priyanka: Agreed. Also add fallback: if aggregator missing for >2m, fall back to scraping the per-device exporters (we still run them but set `honor_labels: false` and lower scrape frequency). Fallback logic would be in Prometheus scrape discovery (prefers aggregator targets) + alerting playbooks.
Kevin: Deployment plan:
- Day 0: push aggregator image to staging, smoke test on 2 nodes
- Day 2: canary rollout 5% nodes labelled `gpu-metrics=agg-canary` (no change to prod scrape config yet)
- Day 3: flip Prom config in staging to scrape aggregator, run evaluation queries and compare series counts, cost estimate
- Day 5: prod canary 10% + monitor cost/alerts for 48h
- Day 8: roll to 70% then full after 24h stable
Maya: Add a feature flag in config map: `enable_pod_level_metrics: false` and `pod_annotation_whitelist: [redwood.io/gpu_metrics]` so we can opt-in only for customers who need per-pod metrics.
Jordan: Ops-bot, can you create a ticket in infra-backlog with the rollout steps and link to the kata benchmark? :clipboard:
ops-bot: Created INFRA-1246: "gpu-aggregator-daemonset rollout" and attached perf numbers. https://tickets.redwood.ai/INFRA-1246 :white_check_mark:
Ryan: A couple of quick queries to validate after canary:
- count series before/after: `count({job="k8s-gpu-exporter"})` vs `count({job="k8s-gpu-aggregator"})`
- aggregate util check: `sum(redwood_gpu_node_utilization) by (node)` should roughly equal `sum(dcgm_gpu_utilization) by (node)` on canary nodes
Priyanka: Also add an alert to notify if series_count drops >85% unexpectedly during rollout (could mean we accidentally dropped important metrics).
Maya: I'll prepare the prometheus PR with relabel and metric_relabel changes and the confmap for feature flags.
Jordan: Good. If no objections I'll start the canary tomorrow morning 09:00 PT. :thumbsup:
Kevin: +1 from me. :rocket:
Priyanka: +1.
Maya: +1.
Jordan: Ok launching canary tomorrow 09:00 PT. Will post updates in this thread. :eyes:
